== Title ==
<span lang="ja">敵を阻め</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">相手がキャラクターか宇宙船を配備した直後に使用する。1フォース消費すること。そのキャラクターまたは宇宙船は、このターンの間中、戦闘と移動を行うことができない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">デス スター内で追跡された末、ルークとレイアは、追ってくるストームトルーパーたちを足止めするため、ブラスト ドアを閉じた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Rebel Barrier]].

'''Lore''' — After being chased through the Death Star, Luke and Leia closed a blast door to halt the pursuing stormtroopers.

'''Game text''' — Use immediately after the opponent deploys a character or starship. Use 1 Force. That character or starship cannot battle or move during this turn.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore says they closed a blast door to halt pursuers. Game text is used immediately after the opponent deploys, rather than preventing a just-deployed card.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-rebelbarrier.gif|Original English face]], [[Rebel Barrier]].</ref>
